description: A clean realizer \(A\) of \(f:\mathbb N^n\rightharpoonup\mathbb N\) has no internal halt. For every input \(\bar x\) and every file \(S\), its actual entry-to-exit execution from the file with inputs \(\bar x\), output zero and work zero reaches \(S\) exactly when \(f(\bar x)\downarrow=b\) for some \(b\) and \(S\) has those same inputs, output \(b\) and work zero.
